title: Warmly Spiced Peruvian Banana Skewers
description: Tangy and crumbly, these festive Peruvian banana skewers are a delicious dessert featuring fried ripe bananas, shio-cure, and high protein friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection on a raclette grill.
instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, cinnamon powder, and nutmeg powder.
Dip each banana into the beaten egg and then coat in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Dip the flour coated banana into the crushed puffed rice cereal, pressing gently to adhere.
Place the coated banana onto a plate or tray, repeat with remaining bananas.
Brush the melted butter onto the raclette grill and cook the banana skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio cure and granulated sugar.
Sprinkle the shio cure mixture over the cooked banana skewers and serve immediately.
